headline: Binance Says It Replenished 90% After Hack
deck: Binance says it set aside about $6.34bn in company funds, while reports place the theft between more than $6bn and $6.43bn.
body: Binance said it replenished approximately 90% of the cryptocurrency stolen in the 29 October hack and set aside about $6.34bn in company funds to cover the losses. It also said it would fully cover the financial impact of the stolen funds. [E1] [E3] [E4] [E5]
The FBI said North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than $6bn in virtual assets from Binance on or about 29 October. [E2]
The reported theft total varies by source: the Guardian described a $6.3bn hack, the FBI said more than $6bn, and Elliptic put the value of cryptoassets stolen at $6.43bn. [E1] [E2] [E5]
